title: Basketball Shooting Percentage by Spot
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=shotarc:make
| stats sum(eval(if(result="make",1,0))) as makes, count as attempts by spot
| eval pct=round(100*makes/attempts,1)
| sort - pct
description: Tracks your make percentage from each spot on the floor so practice targets your genuine cold zones, not your favourites.
value: Shooters over-practise their strengths; a spot-by-spot percentage exposes the weak areas that actually need the reps.
implementation: Feed shot-tracker results into `index=personal`; review shooting percentage by location.
visualization: Shot chart of make percentage by spot.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how often you score from each spot on the court, so you practise the places you actually miss.
